about.title: About
about.subtitle: Discover our mission, vision, and the people driving Web3 innovation in Central Africa.
about.missionDesc: Turn the potential of Goma’s youth into real impact through hybrid innovation. We educate, mentor, and equip local talent with blockchain technologies and sustainable agriculture practices.
about.visionDesc: Propelling the DRC as the leading hybrid innovation hub in Central Africa, by training a new generation of leaders able to transform the digital economy (Web3/Blockchain) and ecological resilience (Sustainable Agriculture).
about.obj1Desc: Comprehensive blockchain education programs for developers and entrepreneurs.
about.obj2Desc: Supporting innovative Web3 projects from ideation to launch.
about.obj3Desc: Connecting builders with mentors, investors, and global communities.
about.obj4Desc: Showcasing local talent and projects on the global blockchain stage.
about.teamIntro: A committed team that turns ideas into concrete, lasting solutions.
about.servicesDesc: Services tailored to your needs, with a constant commitment to quality, reliability, and every client's satisfaction.
about.service1Desc: A progressive path helping learners move from zero to independent practice with technology tools.
about.service1Intro: Our integration programme is designed to build participants' skills through practical learning and close support.
about.service1Point1: Intensive 4-to-8-week bootcamps with weekly practical exercises.
about.service1Point2: Blockchain & Web3, Artificial Intelligence, No-Code and digital productivity tools.
about.service1Point3: One-to-one coaching, portfolio development and career guidance.
about.service1Point4: Project-based learning with a final assessment built around a concrete mini-project.
about.service2Desc: Operation and maintenance of validator nodes and stake pools with continuous monitoring.
about.service3Desc: End-to-end digital solutions, from web applications to blockchain integration.
about.service4Desc: Professional office services that make document workflows more reliable.
about.service5Desc: Strategic support to turn an idea into an executable project.
about.service6Desc: Technology solutions supporting sustainable agriculture and community resilience.
about.service2Intro: Reliable blockchain infrastructure operations for projects seeking stability and availability.
about.service3Intro: Custom digital products from design through production with client support.
about.service4Intro: Modern administrative support to save time and make document workflows more reliable.
about.service5Intro: A practical method for turning an idea into a realistic, executable action plan.
about.service6Intro: Field support for green initiatives combining social, environmental and digital impact.
about.service6Point1: Design of local sustainable agriculture initiatives.
about.service6Point4: Simplified environmental and social impact measurement.
about.heroDesc: Ynuka Labs is a Web3 innovation centre in Goma. We train talent, incubate projects and operate blockchain infrastructure for communities in DR Congo.
about.historyP1: Long known as Goma Hub, Ynuka Labs was born in 2022, continuing the Cardano Summit held in 2021 at ISDR-GL by Gentil Samvura.
about.historyP2: That initiative marked the start of our commitment to the Cardano ecosystem. With support from Project Catalyst and various collaborations, we built training programs, community events, and Web3 / Cardano blockchain initiation activities. Since our beginnings, more than 500 young Congolese people have taken part in our trainings and gatherings.
about.historyP3: Our commitment also goes beyond the digital. We have supported displaced people and led environmental initiatives, including tree-planting campaigns.
about.historyP4: In 2026, Goma Hub became Ynuka Labs. This evolution reflects our will to build a stronger identity and carry a long-term vision : from Goma to the DRC, Africa, and beyond.
about.interv1Desc: Training, workshops and mentoring so young people and professionals can build practical skills in digital technology and innovation.
about.interv2Desc: Design of applications, platforms and solutions tailored to the needs of businesses, organisations and communities : especially in blockchain, Web3 and software development.
interv2Points: Solutions for businesses, organisations and communities
about.interv3Desc: Support for innovative ideas and projects, from concept through to solutions that answer local and regional realities.
interv3Points: Answers to local and regional realities
about.interv4Desc: Technology and community initiatives for responsible agriculture, reforestation and environmental resilience.

onboarding.title: Onboarding Program
onboarding.subtitle: Helping new members integrate into the Ynuka Labs ecosystem.
onboarding.whatDesc: The Onboarding Program is a structured welcome path that helps new members understand the ecosystem, tools, and opportunities within Ynuka Labs.
onboarding.impactDesc: This program improves member retention, speeds up practical learning, and increases the number of participants who move into real project execution.
onboarding.donateDesc: Your contributions help us fund intro sessions, learning resources, and onboarding support for new participants.
onboarding.storyText: Since 2023, Ynuka Labs identified a strong need for Web3 education, especially around the Cardano blockchain. This led us to launch this program, through which at the end of each month we mobilize our limited resources and recruit young entrepreneurs, students, and technology enthusiasts to provide a one-week training on topics such as Web3, distributed ledger technology, blockchain, Cardano wallets, and other practical foundations for their journey.
